washing-machine.definition: An electric appliance that cleans clothes by moving them through water and detergent. It then rinses the clothes and spins them to remove excess water.

dryer.definition: (of liquor) having a low residual sugar content because of decomposition of sugar during fermentation.

front-loader.definition: A washing machine with a door on the front through which laundry is loaded.
front-loader.exampleUsage: The front-loader uses a horizontal drum.

top-loader.definition: A washing machine with a lid on the top through which laundry is loaded.

spin-cycle.definition: The stage of a washing-machine program when the drum rotates rapidly to extract water from the clothes.
spin-cycle.exampleUsage: The spin cycle was used during the activity.

rinse.definition: The removal of soap with clean water in the final stage of washing.

wash.definition: The dry bed of an intermittent stream (as at the bottom of a canyon).

tumble-dry.definition: Dry laundry by rotating it inside a drum while heated air removes its moisture.

coin-slot.definition: An opening in a machine where coins are inserted to start or play a game.
coin-slot.exampleUsage: The coin slot was used during the activity.

start-button.definition: A physical button that begins a device's operation or starts a process when pressed.
start-button.exampleUsage: The start button was used during the activity.

detergent.definition: A surface-active chemical widely used in industry and laundering.

fabric-softener.definition: A laundry product used during washing or rinsing to make fabrics feel softer and reduce static.
fabric-softener.exampleUsage: The label explains where fabric softener may be used.

bleach.definition: The whiteness that results from removing the color from something.

stain-remover.definition: A cleaning product designed to help remove marks or stains from fabric or other surfaces.
stain-remover.exampleUsage: The stain remover was tested on an inconspicuous area first.

dryer-sheet.definition: A thin sheet placed in a clothes dryer to reduce static and add softness or fragrance.
dryer-sheet.exampleUsage: A dryer sheet was placed with the laundry according to the package directions.

lint-roller.definition: A hand-held sticky roller used to remove lint, hair, or small fibers from clothing.
lint-roller.exampleUsage: The lint roller removed pet hair from the jacket.

clothespin.definition: A small clip used to fasten laundry to a drying line.

mesh-bag.definition: A bag made from net-like fabric, often used to protect small or delicate laundry items during washing.
mesh-bag.exampleUsage: Delicate socks were placed in a mesh bag.

shirt.definition: A garment worn on the upper body, usually with sleeves.

pants.definition: (used in the plural) underpants worn by women.

socks.definition: Hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot.

underwear.definition: Undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments.

towel.definition: A piece of absorbent cloth used for drying your body or other things.

dress.definition: Clothing of a distinctive style or for a particular occasion.

jacket.definition: A short outer garment worn over other clothes.

jeans.definition: A coarse durable twill-weave cotton fabric.

load.definition: An amount of alcohol sufficient to intoxicate.

unload.definition: To remove the load from (a container or vehicle).

fold.definition: An angular or rounded shape made by folding.

iron.definition: A heated appliance used to smooth wrinkles in clothes.

hang.definition: A special way of doing something.

stain-treat.definition: To apply a suitable cleaning treatment to a stain before or during laundering.
stain-treat.exampleUsage: She treated the stain according to the garment-care label.

pre-soak.definition: To soak laundry in water or a cleaning solution before the main wash.
pre-soak.exampleUsage: The care instructions recommend a short pre-soak for the muddy uniform.

spin.definition: To rotate quickly around a central point.

dry.definition: (of liquor) having a low residual sugar content because of decomposition of sugar during fermentation.

folding-table.definition: A flat table used for sorting and folding clean laundry.
folding-table.exampleUsage: Clean clothes were folded on the folding table.

cart.definition: To transport something in a cart.

bench.definition: The reserve players on a team.

vending-machine.definition: A machine that dispenses products after a customer inserts payment.
vending-machine.exampleUsage: The vending machine was used during the activity.

change-machine.definition: A machine that exchanges bills or larger coins for smaller coins or tokens.
change-machine.exampleUsage: The change machine provided coins for the laundry machines.

sign.definition: A board showing rules or information.

floor-drain.definition: An opening in a floor that allows water or other liquid to flow into a drainage system.
floor-drain.exampleUsage: The floor drain helps remove spilled water.

lost-and-found.definition: A place where lost objects and people are reported or collected.

label.definition: A brief description given for purposes of identification.

delicate.definition: Exquisitely fine and subtle and pleasing.

wool.definition: Soft hair from sheep, used to make warm cloth.

silk.definition: A fabric made from the fine threads produced by certain insect larvae.
silk.exampleUsage: The silk was identified during the lesson.

cold-wash.definition: A laundry wash cycle that uses cold or cool water.
cold-wash.exampleUsage: The care label recommends a cold wash.

warm-wash.definition: A laundry wash cycle that uses warm water.
warm-wash.exampleUsage: The machine has a warm-wash setting.

tumble-dry-low.definition: A clothing-care instruction meaning to dry the item in a tumble dryer using low heat.
tumble-dry-low.exampleUsage: The care label says 'tumble dry low.'

hang-dry.definition: To dry clothing by hanging it in the air rather than using a tumble dryer.
hang-dry.exampleUsage: The delicate shirt should hang dry.

dry-clean-only.definition: A care-label instruction meaning the item should be professionally dry-cleaned rather than washed normally.
dry-clean-only.exampleUsage: The jacket label says 'dry clean only.'

timer.definition: A device that measures or signals the end of baking time.
timer.exampleUsage: The timer was used during the activity.

basket.definition: The quantity contained in a basket.
